name: SpaceMapper AOE Source
description: Read SpaceMapper's AOE catalog records (its SGP4 two-line sets, the NORAD number it gives or aoe:<id>, the channel) into canonical SDS OMM records and an id crosswalk of candidate identity links. Retrieval and page decoding belong to the SDN host flow.

methods.displayName: Read AOE element sets as OMM

acceptedTypeSets.description: AOE catalog records as the host extracted them from SpaceMapper's pages: JSON lines (one object per element set, as the archive's records.jsonl) or one JSON array of objects, bounded to 128 MiB.

wildcardJustification.detail: AOE catalog records as the host extracted them from SpaceMapper's pages: JSON lines (one object per element set, as the archive's records.jsonl) or one JSON array of objects, bounded to 128 MiB.

inputPorts.description: AOE catalog records as the host extracted them from SpaceMapper's pages: JSON lines (one object per element set, as the archive's records.jsonl) or one JSON array of objects, bounded to 128 MiB.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Canonical size-prefixed OMM records in input order, one per element set that could be read, without padding between them.

outputPorts.description: Canonical size-prefixed OMM records in input order, one per element set that could be read, without padding between them.

acceptedTypeSets.description: What AOE states about each object, from its newest set, as candidates: its own id (aoe:<id>), the NORAD number and the international designator it gives, its name, class and channel; conflicts between sets listed. Identity evidence for the $CAT integrator, never an assertion.

Identity evidence for the $CAT integrator, never an assertion.

outputPorts.description: What AOE states about each object, from its newest set, as candidates: its own id (aoe:<id>), the NORAD number and the international designator it gives, its name, class and channel; conflicts between sets listed. Identity evidence for the $CAT integrator, never an assertion.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Counts of the records read, emitted and dropped (and why, with the first examples), duplicates, Alpha-5 numbers, mismatched checksums and objects with no NORAD number; module control metadata the host keeps beside the input, not an observation.

wildcardJustification.detail: Counts of the records read, emitted and dropped (and why, with the first examples), duplicates, Alpha-5 numbers, mismatched checksums and objects with no NORAD number; module control metadata the host keeps beside the input, not an observation.

outputPorts.description: Counts of the records read, emitted and dropped (and why, with the first examples), duplicates, Alpha-5 numbers, mismatched checksums and objects with no NORAD number; module control metadata the host keeps beside the input, not an observation.

sequentialJustification.detail: One complete bounded set of provider records is read in input order into canonical records and two control frames; the host parallelizes independent snapshots and this parser creates no threads.
